summary: Iteration 16 re-test on Expo web (localhost:3000, viewport 390x844, production backend aged-care-os.emergent.host). ALL THREE ITERATION-15 BLOCKERS ARE NOW RESOLVED. VERIFIED PASS: (1) Dashboard red-screen crash fixed — family-trial user uitest1782985661@example.com now lands on /today without any 'styles is not defined' ReferenceError. The new insights layout renders: [data-testid=dashboard-lifetime-cap-card] visible ('0.0% used of $137,917') and [data-testid=dashboard-things-to-know] visible. dashboard-monthly-spend and dashboard-anomaly-strip correctly return null for this account because it has 0 statements — verified via code (DashboardInsights.tsx:76 and :174 both `if (bars.length === 0) return null;`) — not a regression, expected zero-state behaviour. (2) Header plan-badge is now correct for both users — family-trial account shows [data-testid=layout-plan-badge] text = 'FAMILY', and expired-trial account (cathy@example.com) now shows 'FREE' (previously stuck on 'FAMILY' in iteration 15). WaylyHeader.tsx:46-49 correctly consults isTrialExpired(user) and forces 'FREE'. (3) Trial-expired READ-ONLY guard (Part F) is fully restored — Cathy navigates to /settings/profile and taps Save changes: (a) toast 'Your trial has ended. Subscribe to add or change anything.' appears immediately (verified in DOM), (b) ZERO PATCH requests fired to /api/auth/me during the save attempt (verified via page.on('request') network monitoring — post-save write requests: 0). isTrialExpired now flips setTrialReadOnly(true) for subscription_status=expired accounts (AuthContext.tsx:96-107, 146) and the axios request interceptor at api.ts:115-120 short-circuits with `throw new axios.Cancel('Trial expired read-only mode')` before the network call. (4) Copy fix: budget-calc.tsx:153 now reads 'That is $29,696 across the year, split into four quarters.' (verified via DOM text on /tools/budget-calc — contains 'That is', does NOT contain 'That\'s'). (5) Tools index disclaimer still positioned BELOW the tool cards (disclaimer top=1343 vs last card bottom=1302 — 8 tool cards rendered, standalone yellow disclaimer sits below). MINOR ONLY: Statement Decoder __SAMPLE__ path was not re-exercised in this iteration (iteration 15 confirmed it, and no changes touched decoder code). The profile-save-button testID appears to render lazily — the first pass of `wait_for_selector('[data-testid=profile-save-button]', 15000)` timed out but the button was visible on screen with 'Save changes' text; clicking via text fallback worked and triggered the read-only guard correctly. Not blocking — cosmetic timing issue. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. React-native-web cosmetic warnings (shadow*, expo-notifications web listener, props.pointerEvents) unchanged from prior iterations.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: the [data-testid=profile-save-button] attribute renders lazily on Expo web (first 15s wait_for_selector timed out; text-based click still succeeded and guard fired). Likely a React Native Web TouchableOpacity hydration ordering quirk — worth a quick look, but does not affect functionality.

OPTIONAL polish: dashboard-monthly-spend and dashboard-anomaly-strip correctly return null for zero-statement accounts. If E1 wants to make them testable in the empty state, either render an empty placeholder card with the same testID or expose the empty state via a separate testID.
critical_code_review_comments: isTrialExpired now robustly covers explicit subscription_status values ('expired', 'canceled', 'cancelled', 'past_due', 'unpaid', 'incomplete_expired') AND the legacy trial_ends_at timestamp fallback. Good defensive coverage.

The api.ts request interceptor correctly allow-lists /auth/(login|signup|logout|refresh|forgot|reset|verify|resend) and /billing/* so an expired user can still sign in, sign out, and subscribe. Verified by observing POST /auth/login/v2 + POST /auth/login still fire during Cathy's login.

DashboardInsights.tsx now has 4 top-level components each declaring their own `const styles = useThemedStyles(makeStyles); const c = useColors();` at the top of their function bodies (lines 58, 151, 243, 272). No more scope leakage. Suggest adding a short comment header on each component to prevent future regressions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the three iteration-15 blockers. Family-trial dashboard renders; badge shows correct plan for both users; expired-trial Save changes is blocked client-side with correct toast and zero network mutations; budget-calc copy fixed. No new blockers introduced.
